description: Whose shortened cue was reconciled and who will keep the plain chamber properties.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Set the full closing words and the winter sign onto all three rolls.
name: Humphrey Larkham

description: Insisted on paper first, then mouths, and entered the eightpence as copying.
name: John Heminges

description: Spoke the settled cue once; voice carries a grain since late September, not to be written lower.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Set the leaf down and left the bundle shut.
name: William Shakespeare
